scope: Read-only diagnosis of the exact failed postpublication payload. No production source, CAD artifact, print mesh or publication was changed by these probes.
cause: flute_payload.placement_onto centers the two mesh bounding boxes. A permitted 0.00660705566406 mm overshoot at one reduced-surface extremum creates half that amount of extra X translation. carried writes it to every vertex. It is real viewer-position drift, not only measurement noise in the verifier.
failed_graft_behavior: The first aggregate graft introduces the inferred shift. The publication graft recovers that same shifted pose and is byte-idempotent; eight matched/replaced entries does not prove their exact semantic placement.
bounded_remedy: In tools/publish_now.py refresh_enclosure_viewer, pre-carry only the two appliance carrier surfaces by the exact facts states[assembly_state].offset_y and graft these pre-positioned surfaces with same_frame=True. Keep generic placement_onto, canonical release-frame part payloads, six static enclosure surfaces and all other consumer placement rules unchanged.
qualification_effect: Viewer-only transform correction. Current native CAD and all printed STEP/STL geometry remain unchanged; original generation receipts retain their source provenance, while the new publication proof binds publisher code and transformed payload.
